ac1_proof.base_side: verbatim transcription of the three inline predicate arms as they stood at 497b905bbd85b85eaa3d222ab9775fdb1b27b643: the DEREF arm at lines 876-886, the JUMP arm at lines 910-922 and the XOR/MUL arm at lines 964-976 of asic_core/rtl/lsc1_packet_frontend.sv. Every quantity is read from the same raw bit offset of frame_payload that the base arms read it from, and the arm dispatch reproduces the base decode ladder's opcode tests, so the base side is a frozen copy of the deleted code rather than a restatement of it in the extracted module's vocabulary.
ac1_proof.head_side: instantiates the shipped lsc1_cell_alias_check, not a transcription of it, so the proof binds the artifact compiled into the design
ac1_proof.note: Opcodes outside the six that evaluate the predicate are tied low on both sides. The base frontend never evaluated the predicate for them, so its value there was a don't-care; tying it low makes both sides total functions and turns the obligation into a comparison of two total functions with no don't-care reasoning. What preserves the fault priority is the ladder position of the three uses, which this slice does not move, and which the AC-5 directed frontend differential pins.
